content_html:
watched #SarileruNeekevvaru : Babu neee Maaassu Bomma Mind Blocku!!!!! Sarileru to MB fans is ….what GabbarSingh was to PK fans _/_ they will enjoy the mass avatar of MB to the core and to neutral audience its a time pass average movie!!!!

to start with I was vexed up with Mahesh’s choice of never ending streak of message oriented and Family based movies for past few years with his similar acting and sloooww dialogue modulation and this movie has breathed fresh air to my expectations of exploring the actors mass acting potential and he completely owned it with his typical comedy timing and entertaing and punchful dialogues and his dance and grace in Mind Block song would be a treat to his Fans!!!!

content wise there is nothing much similar to many mass movies but as MB has tried this genere after a looooong gap it feels refreshing _/_

Director Anil has tried hard to meet the expectations on his comedy track due to past track and that has resulted in him overdoing it and the whole train comedy is filled with over acting of Sangeetha, Rashmika & others…..specific genre of audience may get irritated with the whole train episode but those who love the masssss comedy will like it to the core ( have seen my daughter laughing out loud for the whole train episode where I was feeling irritated with the never ending silly comedy ) and the climax though tried to be different is very weak and illogical even for a mass movie!!!! but the confrontation scenes between Prakash Raj, Vijayashanti and MB in 2nd half have been handeled superbly with both powerful punches as well as comedy!!!!

though music from DSP was very oridinary the songs have been shot well however the BGM is superb and elevates the heroism to next level!!!

overall it would be a runaway hit in B & C centers as they find the movie as complete package where as in A centers the silly comedy in first half and illogical climax may impact it along with how good
Ala Vaikunthapurramloo is!!!!
